models_evaluated: PPG-based deep learning sleep staging model

links.outcome: Sleep staging performance by device placement (wrist vs upper arm)
links.effect: Median accuracy 80.8% and Cohen's Kappa 0.7 at wrist; at upper arm accuracy decreased by approximately 6.2% and Kappa by 10%. IBI-based model showed no degradation at upper arm.
links.quote: A reduction in performance was observed when the device was worn at the upper arm, with accuracy decreasing by approximately 6.2% and Cohen's Kappa by 10%.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the diagnostic/classification performance of deep learning models for sleep staging using PPG data gathered from 134 clinical trial patients against PSG, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
